section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analysis procedures used to examine the factor structure of the Indonesian Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) separately for women and men using exploratory factor analysis with quartimax rotation. The analyses included parallel analysis to determine factor retention, a 3×2 ANOVA to examine between-group differences across ethnicity (Javanese, Sundanese, Chinese) and gender, and bivariate correlations between factor scores and participant BMI. No specific demographic or sample characteristics are provided in this methods section.
